title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Fee Schedule: Payments, Late Charges and Courtesy Waivers
content:
**Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease — payment and term-fee figures by tier**

**Posting cutoff and allocation (all tiers)**

- A payment received by 20:00 Central Time on a business day posts that day.
- A monthly payment is applied in this order: monthly use tax, then rent charge, then depreciation, then term fees due.

**Convenience fee by payment channel (all tiers)**

| Channel | Fee collected on top of the payment |
|---|---|
| Online ACH | $0.00 |
| Autopay ACH | $0.00 |
| Self-service phone line, ACH | $0.00 |
| Phone representative, ACH | $0.00 |
| Phone representative, debit card | $5.95 |
| Mailed check | $0.00 |
| Cashier's check | $0.00 |
| Wire | $0.00 |
| MoneyGram | $0.00 |

**Late charges and returned-payment fees (all tiers)**

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Grace period after a payment due date | 10 calendar days |
| Late charge | 5 percent of the unpaid portion of the total monthly payment |
| Company maximum late charge per payment | $30 |
| Unpaid portion below which no late charge is assessed | $10 |
| Company returned-payment fee | $25 |

**Courtesy late-charge waivers, by tier**

| Tier | Courtesy waivers allowed in any 12 calendar months | Payments in a row without a late charge required |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Lease Tier 5 | 0 (none) | 12 |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 4 | 0 (none) | 12 |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 3 | 1 | 9 |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 2 | 1 | 6 |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 1 | 1 | 6 |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 1+ | 2 | 6 |

**Reading the schedule**

- The company maximum and the company returned-payment fee are applied before the state maximum recorded on the individual lease; the lower figure is the one charged.
- Hypothetical illustration: an unpaid portion of $9.99 draws no late charge, because it is below $10; an unpaid portion of $400 gives 5 percent, $20, which is under the $30 company maximum.
